notes.title: Upgrade to version 0.2.0
notes.content:
In this update:

[list]
[*] A new opponent has been added.
[*] Added slots for rings, as well as the rings themselves.
[*] A rollover to the character has been added.
[*] Some visual effects have been changed.
[*] Fixed a bug with achievements. (they were not issued)
[*] The Statistics tab has been added.
[*] The "100% Improvement" scroll has been added. It allows you to improve an item with 100% probability.
[*] Added the display of damage to the enemy.
[/list]
